8b875d5b595d19c4.job_title: Physician (MD/DO) - Put Medical AI to the Test, Remote
8b875d5b595d19c4.description: About the company Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project. Project Highlights Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases All contributors are license-verified physicians $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved What this project involves We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may: Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems; Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality; Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales. Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself. What we look for This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have: Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly); Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome; Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine); Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines; Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus); Strong written English (C1+). This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles. How it works Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks Flexibility You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria. Earnings Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate. $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved. Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

8b7f7f630a167bdd.description: About Think Think AI, founded in Riyadh in 2025, focuses on enhancing compute efficiency by integrating hardware and software design. The company aims to redefine AI infrastructure from the silicon up, building efficient compute platforms where hardware and software co-evolve to maximize intelligence. This approach seeks to enable scalable AI operations without compromise or wasted compute. The Role: Hardware System Architect Lead GPU Platform Think AI is seeking a Hardware System Architect Lead for GPU Platforms. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves owning the architecture of multi-accelerator server platforms and the ILM orchestration platform. The initial focus will be on a high-density, multi-accelerator system designed for mixed-silicon fabrics, supporting NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel accelerators. The role requires taking platforms from block diagram to manufacturing release and setting the direction for future node generations. Over time, this position will build an in-house board design team. Key Responsibilities Own the end-to-end system architecture, including CPU platform selection, PCIe Gen5 and Gen6 topology, switch selection and partitioning, lane budgets, and GPU-to-NIC affinity. Design for GPUDirect RDMA and peer-to-peer traffic across heterogeneous accelerators, validating ACS, ATS, IOMMU, and P2P behavior for each silicon vendor. Manage the signal integrity strategy across retimers, MCIO, cabled PCIe, risers, backplanes, and channel loss budgets, collaborating with layout and SI engineers. Lead power and thermal architecture for dense, high-TDP accelerator configurations, covering CRPS power delivery, airflow, and liquid-cooling readiness. Define BIOS/UEFI and BMC requirements, working with the ILM software team on bring-up, telemetry, firmware, and fabric integration. Write platform specifications and reference designs for JDM partners, and own design reviews of schematics, layouts, and BOMs. Select and manage ODM and JDM partners for motherboards, chassis, and PCIe switches, driving platforms through EVT, DVT, and PVT into production. Lead the transition from JDM to in-house board design, taking ownership of schematics, layout, and SI/PI, and define the roadmap for future generations, including Gen6 switching, CXL, and rack-scale integration. Own platform validation and quality strategy, including validation plans, qualification matrices, and entry/exit criteria for EVT, DVT, and PVT. Drive Design for Test and Manufacturing (DFx) with the manufacturing team to ensure testability at board, server, and rack levels. Lead failure analysis and root cause for platform issues from power-on through mass production, developing corrective-action reports and debug guides. Build validation and test automation in Python and Bash, integrated with ILM telemetry. Build and lead the hardware platform team, including board design, SI/PCIe, mechanical/thermal, platform firmware, and platform validation and test. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in hardware system architecture. Demonstrated experience in shipping dense multi-GPU platforms. Experience with lane budgets, switch partitioning, and bringing systems through EVT, DVT, and PVT into volume production. Proficiency in platform quality assurance, including validation at board, server, and rack levels. Company Values Think AI operates on four core principles: Ownership: Taking responsibility for outcomes, managing resources frugally, and prioritizing the mission. 8b85c99c3af31695.description: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. Join Visa and do work that matters to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. With our deep knowledge and expertise, we bring the voice of the customer into the design, development and successful deployment of Visa products and services. In this highly visible role, you will drive complex, technology-driven payment solutions by providing dedicated program management, implementation support, and technical expertise. You will be expected to lead and execute high-quality, non-routine, market-wide complex projects, as well as tactical and strategic client initiatives. This includes providing end-to-end project and program management across cross-functional workstreams and multiple initiatives required to achieve business objectives. The ideal candidate is a hybrid professional: a strong technical program manager with a solid technical background in payments, a trusted client advisor, and a growth-minded individual who will help strengthen and scale the Advisory Implementation value proposition across CEMEA. 8b4c7b4a1d471add.description: About ZeroFox ZeroFox is the trusted solution for defending organizations against daily cyber threats that erode revenue, damage reputation, and frustrate security and risk teams.
